claims.claim_text: The indexed Joseph H Devlin has a high-confidence match to an Army enlistment entry of the same name.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official Army bulk record agrees with the NARA index on the full name and a protected unique identifier. It does not name a civilian employer.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence: exact name and unique protected identifier agree; Box 183 personnel file remains unreviewed.
claims.temporal_assessment: Army enlistment evidence is wartime identity context, not proof of immediately pre-OSS work.
claims.match_notes: Do not associate a modern attorney of the same name with this wartime record.

claims.claim_text: A 1944 OSS Cairo report names a USNR lieutenant (junior grade) Carl Devoe; whether he is the index's Carl Devoe is unresolved.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Labor Section, Lt. (jg) Carl Devoe, USNR, Acting Chief.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The original OSS report names a naval officer in Cairo. The index prints only 'Lt'; a protected identifier separately matches an Army enlistment entry for Carl Devoe. The records have not been reconciled.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Same full name, rank family and OSS context are suggestive, but neither the Cairo report nor the index supplies a shared branch, file number or personal identifier.
claims.temporal_assessment: The October 1944 report documents wartime OSS work, not a pre-OSS employer.
claims.match_notes: The Army entry was a private at enlistment; later promotion or a different namesake are both possible. Do not assign the Navy officer's career to the indexed person before Box 183 review.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Charles E DeVogel has a high-confidence match to an Army enlistment entry filed as De Vogel.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official Army bulk record agrees on given names and a protected unique identifier; only surname spacing differs. No named pre-OSS employer is supplied.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence based on protected unique identifier plus name elements; Box 184 file remains unreviewed.
claims.temporal_assessment: Army entry data identify a candidate service person, not the immediate pre-OSS employer.
claims.match_notes: An English marriage-index namesake has no U.S. Army or OSS linkage and is not used.

claims.claim_text: The indexed 'Phillippe DeVomecourt' resembles an SOE organizer named Philippe de Vomécourt, but the identity is unverified.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index provides only the unusual similar name and Box 184. Two institutional biographies identify Philippe de Vomécourt as an SOE figure, but neither connects him to this OSS personnel file. A candidate employer in one biography is withheld from this profile.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Ambiguous: similar distinctive spelling is one clue, with no common identifier, direct OSS personnel-file reference or independent recruitment link.
claims.temporal_assessment: The candidate biography describes work before SOE service, not a verified pre-OSS chronology for this indexed entity.
claims.match_notes: Do not silently correct the printed Phillippe DeVomecourt spelling or assign Société de gérance des wagons de grande capacité to this entity until Box 184 establishes identity.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked NARA row establishes Francis T Devlin in Box 183. Search results for same-name veterans and obituaries lack a Box 183 or wartime OSS identity bridge.
person_updates.next_action: Review Francis T Devlin's Box 183 file for full identity, last civilian employer and path into OSS.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index and official Army bulk entry agree on Joseph H Devlin and a protected unique identifier; the Army entry does not identify a civilian employer. A modern attorney namesake is unlinked.
person_updates.next_action: Review Joseph H Devlin's Box 183 file for pre-service employer, Army assignment and OSS transfer chronology.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Only the visually checked Joseph B Devlin index row and Box 183 are established; modern namesakes and directory results do not identify this wartime person.
person_updates.next_action: Review Joseph B Devlin's Box 183 file for identity, prior work and OSS assignment.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index spells the name Elleen M Devney in Box 183. Eileen or Deveney spellings remain search variants only; no external identity bridge was accepted.
person_updates.next_action: Review Elleen M Devney's Box 183 file for her name, wartime role and prior employer or occupation.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index and official Army bulk entry agree on Carl Devoe and a protected unique identifier. The index prints 'Lt' without a branch, while a separate 1944 OSS Cairo report names a USNR Lt. (jg) Carl Devoe. That naval officer is an unconfirmed same-name lead, not a merged identity or employer.
person_updates.next_action: Review Carl Devoe's Box 183 file against the Army entry and the 1944 Cairo report; establish service branch and pre-OSS employer without merging a naval namesake by assumption.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index names Charles E DeVogel; the official Army bulk entry spaces the surname De Vogel and agrees on a protected unique identifier. No named employer is present.
person_updates.next_action: Review Charles E DeVogel's Box 184 file for his civilian employer and Army-to-OSS pathway.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Only the visually checked Sarah J DeVol index row and Box 184 are established; generic cemetery and surname hits do not supply a wartime identity bridge.
person_updates.next_action: Review Sarah J DeVol's Box 184 file for identity, personnel status and prior employer or occupation.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked NARA index spells the name Phillippe DeVomecourt and gives Box 184, with no rank or identifier. Institutional histories document a similarly named SOE organizer, Philippe de Vomécourt, but neither history establishes that he is this OSS-index person.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 184 before matching this row to Philippe de Vomécourt or assigning the candidate's 1940 railway-company employment.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Only the visually checked Clyde H Devore index row and Box 184 are established. A same-name genealogical entry has no independent OSS identifier or employer evidence.
person_updates.next_action: Review Clyde H Devore's Box 184 file for identity, civilian work and military-to-OSS chronology.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index lists Raymond Devos as a first lieutenant in Box 184. Searches are dominated by an entertainer of the same name and an uninspected French dossier locator; neither identifies this indexed officer.
person_updates.next_action: Review Raymond Devos's Box 184 file for nationality, service branch, identity and last pre-OSS affiliation; do not assign the entertainer's biography.
